definition: A condition where air in the small airways of the lungs is replaced with fluid, solid, or other material (pus, blood, water, stomach contents, or cells).
general_symptoms: coughing up thick green or bloody sputum
breathing that sounds funny or is noisy
general_outlook: With appropriate treatment, consolidation usually goes away and air returns
The underlying illness can be serious, but many can be easily treated and cured
Starting treatment early in your illness usually gives you a better outcome

underlying_causes_and_treatments.mechanism: Infection in the lung causes white blood cells to build up dead cells and debris, creating pus that fills the small airways.
targeted_treatment: Medication targeted to the specific organism (antibiotics, antivirals, or antifungals)
Medication to control cough, chest pain, or fever

underlying_causes_and_treatments.mechanism: Increased pressure pushes fluid from lung blood vessels into small airways, or fluid enters airways from outside the body.
sub_causes: Congestive heart failure (heart can’t pump hard enough, backing up blood into lung vessels)
Near-drowning (fluid entering airways from outside body)
targeted_treatment: Medication to lower blood vessel pressure
Medication to make the heart pump better

underlying_causes_and_treatments.mechanism: Bleeding in the lungs caused by inflammation of blood vessels making them weak and leaky.
Breathing food particles or stomach contents into the lungs.
sub_causes: Decreased level of consciousness (increases risk for pneumonitis)

targeted_treatment: Evaluation and treatment for swallowing problems

complications.mechanism: Stomach acid and chemicals cause non-infectious inflammation/injury to lungs.
targeted_treatment: Supportive care while the body heals

underlying_causes_and_treatments.mechanism: Tumor cells occupying or blocking lung space.
targeted_treatment: Symptom management treatment (if cancer has spread)
outlook: Takes more lives each year than prostate, colon, and breast cancer combined
Uncurable once it starts to spread

differential_diagnosis.key_difference: Fluid accumulates in the pleural space outside the lung (moves with gravity), whereas consolidation is fluid inside the lung tissue (does not move with position changes).
